title: ロボットプログラミングⅡ
subtitle: Robot Programming II
keywords: Robot programming 2.wheeled robot 3.Robot arm 4.Legged robot 5.ROS, C++
educationalGoal: (1) Learn the basic theory of robotics. (2) Learn the C++ programming language. (3) Learn the Robot Operating System (ROS). (4) Learn how to develop software for robots, including wheeled robots, robotic arms, and legged robots.
advice: This is a unique course that provides instruction on the basics of robotics and robot programming from a global perspective. This course serves as a hub for theory and practice. To develop an intelligent robot, a large-scale program is needed. Thus, students will learn the ROS and C++ language, which are used very often. C++ is learned using a flipped classroom style. Students watch videos and take quizzes before class, and programming exercises are held in class. This class will cover the following topics: 1. Development environment and ROS installation 2. C++ language 3. Wheeled robot 4. Robot arm 5. Legged robot 6. Programming exercises
